   "source" : "#\n# BNF-style language\n#\n\ndescription::\t\t\tI {print(\"HELLO\\n\")}\n -> construction_start\n -> node\n -> dquote_str\n -> squote_str\n -> regex\n -> group\n -> pipe\n -> star\n -> plus\n -> q_mark\n -> g_repetition\n \nconstruction_start:\t/[a-zA-Z_]\\w*\\s*->/\tI {\n\ttext = entry_text();\n\tsubstr(text, \"\\\\s*->$\", \"\", o);\n\tprint(\"(construction_start)         -I- seen(\", text, \")\\n\")\n}\n\nnode: \t\t\t/[a-zA-Z_]\\w*/\t\tI {print(\"(node)         -I- <\", entry_text(), \">\\n\")}\ndquote_str:\t\t/\"[^\"]+\"/\t\tI {\n\ttext = entry_text();\n\tsubstr(text, \"^(?:\\\")|(?:\\\")$\", \"\", go);\n\tprint(\"(dquote_str)         -I- seen(\", text, \")\\n\")\n}\n\nsquote_str:\t\t/'[^']+?'/\t\tI {\n\ttext = entry_text();\n\tsubstr(text, \"^'|'$\", \"\", go);\n\tprint(\"(squote_str)         -I- seen(\", text, \")\\n\")\n}\n\nregex:\t\t\t/\\/.+\\//\t\tI {\n\ttext = entry_text();\n\tsubstr(text, \"^/|/$\", \"\", go);\n\tprint(\"(regex)         -I- seen#\", text, \"#\\n\")\n}\n\ngroup: \t\t\t/\\(/ /\\)/\t\tI {print(\"(group)        -I-  ****************************************** Entering\\n\")}\nLS {print(\"LOOP START Message\\n\")}\nLE {print(\"LOOP END Message\\n\")}\n -> group\n -> node\n -> dquote_str\n -> squote_str\n -> pipe\n -> regex\n -> star\n -> plus\n -> q_mark\n -> g_repetition\n -> group[1]\t\t\t  \t  \t  { \n\t print(\"(group)        -I-  ########################################## Leaving\\n\");\n\t return(1);\n }\n\ng_repetition: \t\t/\\{(?:\\d+(?:,\\d*)?|,\\d+)\\}/\tI {print(\"(g_repetition) -I- <\", entry_text(), \">\\n\")}\nq_mark: \t\t/\\?/\t\t\tI {print(\"(q_mark)       -I- ?\\n\")}\nplus: \t\t\t/\\+/\t\t\tI {print(\"(plus)         -I- +\\n\")}\nstar: \t\t\t/\\*/\t\t\tI {print(\"(start)        -I- *\\n\")}\npipe: \t\t\t/\\|/\t\t\tI {print(\"(pipe)         -I- |\\n\")} \n",

   "source" : "# ADR0124: complete documents with exact token kinds and source spelling.\n# Select this grammar explicitly; Lispish retains its extraction contract.\n# Validate any original prefix skipped by public parser entry before reading forms.\nDocument::\nI {\n if(matches(input_slice(0, cursor_pos()), /[^ \\t\\r\\n\\f\\x0B]/));\n  exit_now(1);\n endif();\n forms = []\n}\n -> Trivia\n -> List { push(forms, call(List)) }\n -> Invalid { exit_now(1) }\nLX {\n if(num_ne(cursor_pos(), input_end_pos()));\n  exit_now(1);\n endif();\n return(hash(\"format\", \"linkedspec-sexpr-v1\", \"forms\", copy(forms)))\n}\n\nList: /\\(/ /\\)/\nI { items = [] }\n -> Trivia\n -> List { push(items, call(List)) }\n -> String { push(items, call(String)) }\n -> Atom { push(items, call(Atom)) }\n -> List[1] { return(hash(\"kind\", \"list\", \"items\", copy(items))) }\n -> Invalid { exit_now(1) }\nLX { exit_now(1) }\n\n# The comment body runs to a line ending or EOF without a backend-specific anchor.\nTrivia: /[ \\t\\r\\n\\f\\x0B]+|;[^\\r\\n]*(?:\\r\\n|\\r|\\n)?/\n\nString: /\"((?:[^\"\\\\]|\\\\[\\s\\S])*)\"/\nI.return(hash(\"kind\", \"string\", \"lexeme\", entry_text()))\n\nAtom: /[^ \\t\\r\\n\\f\\x0B()\\[\\]{}\";]+/\nI {\n spelling = entry_text();\n if(matches(spelling, /^[+-]?(?:0[xX][0-9a-fA-F](?:_?[0-9a-fA-F])*|(?:[0-9](?:_?[0-9])*(?:\\.[0-9](?:_?[0-9])*)?|\\.[0-9](?:_?[0-9])*)(?:[eE][+-]?[0-9](?:_?[0-9])*)?)$/));\n  return(hash(\"kind\", \"number\", \"lexeme\", spelling));\n else();\n  return(hash(\"kind\", \"symbol\", \"lexeme\", spelling));\n endif()\n}\n\n# These catch-all edges reject text that normal seek dispatch could skip.\nInvalid: /[\\s\\S]/\n",

capt.first();\n  if(str_eq(first_capt[0], \"?branch:\"));\n   entry_tag = \"?branch_entry:\";\n  else();\n   entry_tag = \"?version_entry:\";\n  endif();\n  push(object_hier, array(entry_tag, copy(capt)));\n endif();\n\n if(is_nonempty(object_hier));\n  current_object_name = cur_object[1];\n  push(vhistory_items, array(\"?object:\", current_object_name, copy(object_hier)));\n endif();\n\n return(array(\"?ds_vhistory:\", copy(vhistory_items)))\n} \n\n-> object             {\n  if(is_nonempty(capt));\n   first_capt = capt.first();\n   if(str_eq(first_capt[0], \"?branch:\"));\n    entry_tag = \"?branch_entry:\";\n   else();\n    entry_tag = \"?version_entry:\";\n   endif();\n   push(object_hier, array(entry_tag, copy(capt)));\n   set(capt, array());\n\n  endif();\n\n  if(is_nonempty(object_hier));\n   current_object_name = cur_object[1];\n   push(vhistory_items, array(\"?object:\", current_object_name, copy(object_hier)));\n   set(object_hier, array());\n  endif();\n\n  cur_object = call(object);\n  print(\"\\tObject   \", cur_object[1], \"\\n\")\n}\n\n\n-> separator          {\n  if(is_nonempty(capt));\n   first_capt = capt.first();\n   if(str_eq(first_capt[0], \"?branch:\"));\n    entry_tag = \"?branch_entry:\";\n   else();\n    entry_tag = \"?version_entry:\";\n   endif();\n   push(object_hier, array(entry_tag, copy(capt)));\n   set(capt, array());\n  endif();\n}\n\n\n-> branch             {push(capt, call(branch))}\n-> version            {push(capt, call(version))}\n-> branch_tags        {push(capt, call(branch_tags))}\n-> version_tags       {push(capt, call(version_tags))}\n-> date               {push(capt, call(date))}\n-> author             {push(capt, call(author))}\n-> comment            {push(capt, call(comment))}\n-> manifest           {push(capt, call(manifest))}\n-> derived_from       {push(capt, call(derived_from))}\n\n\n\nseparator:    /-{20,}/\nobject:       /(?i)\\nobject:\\s+(\\S+)/ flat_array(entry_groups())))\nversion_tags: /(?is)\\nversion\\s+tags:\\s+(?:([^:]+?),\\s*(.+?)\\s*,\\s*(\\w+)|(\\S+))/  I.return(array(\"?version_tags:\", flat_array(entry_groups())))\nversion:      /(?i)\\nversion:\\s+(\\S+)/                                            I.return(array(\"?version:\", flat_array(entry_groups())))\ndate:         /(?i)\\ndate:\\s+(.+)/                                                I.return(array(\"?date:\", flat_array(entry_groups())))\ncomment:      /(?i)\\ncomment:\\s+(.+)/                                             I.return(array(\"?comment:\", request.source:
# Grammar parser for := style rules
# This spec will parse EBNF-style grammar definitions

grammar_file:: I {
  rules = [];
  rule = [];
  includes = [];
  semantic_annotations = [];
  rule_header = undef;
  on = undef
}

LX {
  if(rule_header);
    push(rules, array(rule_header, flat_array(rule)));
  endif();

  return(array(flat_array(includes), flat_array(rules)))
}

-> include_dir.push(includes)
-> include_file.push(includes)

-> grammar_rule   {
  if(rule_header);
    push(rules, array(rule_header, flat_array(rule)));
  endif();

  set(rule, array(flat_array(semantic_annotations)));
  set(semantic_annotations, array());

  rule_header = call(grammar_rule);
  on = 1
}

-> rule_name
  .if(on)
    .push(rule_name, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Rule name '", entry_text(), "' reference with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> quoted_string
  .if(on)
    .push(quoted_string, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Quoted string <", entry_text(), "> occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> number
  .if(on)
    .push(number, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Number '", entry_text(), "' occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> quantifier
  .if(on)
    .push(quantifier, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Quantifier occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> plus_operator
  .if(on)
    .push(plus_operator, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: '+' operator occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> return_scalar_value
  .if(on)
    .push(return_scalar_value, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Scalar return annotation occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> return_array_value
  .if(on)
    .push(return_array_value, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Array return annotation occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> return_object
  .if(on)
    .push(return_object, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Object return annotation occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> star_operator
  .if(on)
    .push(star_operator, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: '*' operator occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> question_operator
  .if(on)
    .push(question_operator, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: '?' operator occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> pipe_operator
  .if(on)
    .push(pipe_operator, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: '|' operator occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> open_paren
  .if(on)
    .push(open_paren, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: '(' occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> close_paren
  .if(on)
    .push(close_paren, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: ')' occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> probability
  .if(on)
    .push(probability, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Probability occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> regex
  .if(on)
    .push(regex, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Regex occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> semantic_annotation.push(semantic_annotations)
-> logging_annotation
  .if(on)
    .push(logging_annotation, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Logging annotation occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> whitespace
-> comment

grammar_rule: /(?m)^\s*([[:alpha:]_]\w*)\s*:{,2}=/  I.return(array("rule", entry_group(0)))
rule_name: /\b[[:alpha:]_]\w*/                      I.return(array("rule_reference", entry_text()))

quoted_string: /"[^"]*"|'[^']*'/  I {value = entry_text(); substr(value, "^(?:'|\")|(?:'|\")$", "", go); return(array("quoted_string", value))}
number: /\b\d+\b/                 I.return(array("number", entry_text()))
quantifier: /\{\s*(?:\d+(?:\s*,\s*\d*)?|,\s*\d+)\s*\}/  I {value = entry_text(); substr(value, "\\{|\\}", "", go); return(array("quantifier", value))}
pipe_operator: /\|/               I.return(array("operator", entry_text()))
plus_operator: /\+/               I.return(array("operator", entry_text()))
star_operator: /\*/               I.return(array("operator", entry_text()))
question_operator: /\?/           I.return(array("operator", entry_text()))
return_scalar_value: /->\s*\K(?:\$\d+|"[^"]*"|'[^']*')/  I.return(array("return_scalar_value", entry_text()))
return_array_value: /->\s*\K(?&array_structure)(?(DEFINE)(?<array_structure>\[(?&content)\])(?<object_structure>\{(?&content)\})(?<content>(?:[^{}\[\]]*|(?&array_structure)|(?&object_structure))*))/   I.return(array("return_array_value", entry_text()))
return_object: /->\s*\K(?&object_structure)(?(DEFINE)(?<array_structure>\[(?&content)\])(?<object_structure>\{(?&content)\})(?<content>(?:[^{}\[\]]*|(?&array_structure)|(?&object_structure))*))/ I.return(array("return_object", entry_text()))
open_paren: /\(/                  I.return(array("group_open", entry_text()))
close_paren: /\)/                 I.return(array("group_close", entry_text()))
probability: /@\d+%?/             I {value = entry_text(); substr(value, "@|%", "", go); return(array("probability", value))}
regex: /(?<!\\)\/.+?(?<!\\)\//    I {value = entry_text(); substr(value, "^/|/$", "", go); return(array("regex", value))}
whitespace: /\s+/
comment: /#.*/
include_dir: /\b(?:include_)?dir\(\s*[^)]*?\s*\)/ I {args = entry_text(); substr(args, "^\s*(?:include_)?dir\(\s*", "", g); substr(args, "\s*\)\s*$", "", g); parts = []; split(parts, args, /\s*,\s*/); trim_each(parts); filter_nonempty(parts); return(array("include_dir", copy(parts)))}
include_file: /\b(?:include(?:_file)?|file)\(\s*[^)]*?\s*\)/ I {args = entry_text(); substr(args, "^\s*(?:include(?:_file)?|file)\(\s*", "", g); substr(args, "\s*\)\s*$", "", g); parts = []; split(parts, args, /\s*,\s*/); trim_each(parts); filter_nonempty(parts); return(array("include_file", copy(parts)))}

semantic_annotation: /@(\w+)\s*:\s*/
I {c = capture_until_boundary(semantic_annotation, grammar_rule); substr(c, "\s*$", "", o); substr(c, "^\"|\"$", "", go); return(array("semantic_annotation", array(entry_group(0), c)))}

logging_annotation: /@((?:log|debug|trace|benchmark|profile|timing)_\w+)\s*\(\s*/ /\s*\)/ I {logging_name = entry_group(0); start_capture_slice()}

-> quoted_string {
  push(quoted_string, 1);
  start_capture_slice()
}
-> comma {
  logging_annotation_part = trim(capture_slice());
  if(is_nonempty(logging_annotation_part));
    push(logging_annotation, logging_annotation_part);
  endif();
  start_capture_slice()
}
-> logging_annotation[1] {
  logging_annotation_part = trim(capture_slice());
  if(is_nonempty(logging_annotation_part));
    push(logging_annotation, logging_annotation_part);
  endif();
  return(array("logging_annotation", array(logging_name, copy(logging_annotation))))
}

comma: /\s*,\s*/

flat_array(rules)))\n}\n\n-> include_dir.push(includes)\n-> include_file.push(includes)\n\n-> grammar_rule   {\n  if(rule_header);\n    push(rules, array(rule_header, flat_array(rule)));\n  endif();\n\n  set(rule, array(flat_array(semantic_annotations)));\n  set(semantic_annotations, array());\n\n  rule_header = call(grammar_rule);\n  on = 1\n}\n\n-> rule_name\n  .if(on)\n    .push(rule_name, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: Rule name '\", entry_text(), \"' reference with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> quoted_string\n  .if(on)\n    .push(quoted_string, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: Quoted string <\", entry_text(), \"> occurrence with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> number\n  .if(on)\n    .push(number, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: Number '\", entry_text(), \"' occurrence with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> quantifier\n  .if(on)\n    .push(quantifier, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: Quantifier occurrence with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> plus_operator\n  .if(on)\n    .push(plus_operator, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: '+' operator occurrence with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> return_scalar_value\n  .if(on)\n    .push(return_scalar_value, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: Scalar return annotation occurrence with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> return_array_value\n  .if(on)\n    .push(return_array_value, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: Array return annotation occurrence with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> return_object\n  .if(on)\n    .push(return_object, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: Object return annotation occurrence with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> star_operator\n  .if(on)\n    .push(star_operator, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: '*' operator occurrence with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> question_operator\n  .if(on)\n    .push(question_operator, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: '?' operator occurrence with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> pipe_operator\n  .if(on)\n    .push(pipe_operator, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: '|' operator occurrence with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> open_paren\n  .if(on)\n    .push(open_paren, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: '(' occurrence with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> close_paren\n  .if(on)\n    .push(close_paren, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: ')' occurrence with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> probability\n  .if(on)\n    .push(probability, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: Probability occurrence with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> regex\n  .if(on)\n    .push(regex, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: Regex occurrence with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> semantic_annotation.push(semantic_annotations)\n-> logging_annotation\n  .if(on)\n    .push(logging_annotation, rule)\n  .else()\n    .say(\"Error: Logging annotation occurrence with no container rule context\")\n    .return_undef()\n  .endif()\n\n-> whitespace\n-> comment\n\ngrammar_rule: /(?m)^\\s*([[:alpha:]_]\\w*)\\s*:{,2}=/  I.return(array(\"rule\", entry_group(0)))\nrule_name: /\\b[[:alpha:]_]\\w*/                      I.return(array(\"rule_reference\", entry_text()))\n\nquoted_string: /\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*'/  I {value = entry_text(); substr(value, \"^(?:'|\\\")|(?:'|\\\")$\", \"\", go); return(array(\"quoted_string\", value))}\nnumber: /\\b\\d+\\b/                 I.return(array(\"number\", entry_text()))\nquantifier: /\\{\\s*(?:\\d+(?:\\s*,\\s*\\d*)?|,\\s*\\d+)\\s*\\}/  I {value = entry_text(); substr(value, \"\\\\{|\\\\}\", \"\", go); return(array(\"quantifier\", value))}\npipe_operator: /\\|/               I.return(array(\"operator\", entry_text()))\nplus_operator: /\\+/               I.return(array(\"operator\", entry_text()))\nstar_operator: /\\*/               I.return(array(\"operator\", entry_text()))\nquestion_operator: /\\?/           I.return(array(\"operator\", entry_text()))\nreturn_scalar_value: /->\\s*\\K(?:\\$\\d+|\"[^\"]*\"|'[^']*')/  I.return(array(\"return_scalar_value\", entry_text()))\nreturn_array_value: I.return(array(\"return_object\", entry_text()))\nopen_paren: /\\(/                  I.return(array(\"group_open\", entry_text()))\nclose_paren: /\\)/                 I.return(array(\"group_close\", copy(parts)))}\n\nsemantic_annotation: /@(\\w+)\\s*:\\s*/\nI {c = capture_until_boundary(semantic_annotation, grammar_rule); substr(c, \"\\s*$\", \"\", o); substr(c, \"^\\\"|\\\"$\", \"\", go); return(array(\"semantic_annotation\", array(entry_group(0), c)))}\n\nlogging_annotation: /@((?:log|debug|trace|benchmark|profile|timing)_\\w+)\\s*\\(\\s*/ /\\s*\\)/ I {logging_name = entry_group(0); start_capture_slice()}\n\n-> quoted_string {\n  push(quoted_string, 1);\n  start_capture_slice()\n}\n-> comma {\n  logging_annotation_part = trim(capture_slice());\n  if(is_nonempty(logging_annotation_part));\n    push(logging_annotation, logging_annotation_part);\n  endif();\n  start_capture_slice()\n}\n-> logging_annotation[1] {\n  logging_annotation_part = trim(capture_slice());\n  if(is_nonempty(logging_annotation_part));\n    push(logging_annotation, logging_annotation_part);\n  endif();\n  return(array(\"logging_annotation\", array(logging_name, observation.source:
# Grammar parser for := style rules
# This spec will parse EBNF-style grammar definitions

grammar_file:: I {
  rules = [];
  rule = [];
  includes = [];
  semantic_annotations = [];
  rule_header = undef;
  on = undef
}

LX {
  if(rule_header);
    push(rules, array(rule_header, flat_array(rule)));
  endif();

  return(array(flat_array(includes), flat_array(rules)))
}

-> include_dir.push(includes)
-> include_file.push(includes)

-> grammar_rule   {
  if(rule_header);
    push(rules, array(rule_header, flat_array(rule)));
  endif();

  set(rule, array(flat_array(semantic_annotations)));
  set(semantic_annotations, array());

  rule_header = call(grammar_rule);
  on = 1
}

-> rule_name
  .if(on)
    .push(rule_name, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Rule name '", entry_text(), "' reference with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> quoted_string
  .if(on)
    .push(quoted_string, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Quoted string <", entry_text(), "> occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> number
  .if(on)
    .push(number, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Number '", entry_text(), "' occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> quantifier
  .if(on)
    .push(quantifier, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Quantifier occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> plus_operator
  .if(on)
    .push(plus_operator, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: '+' operator occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> return_scalar_value
  .if(on)
    .push(return_scalar_value, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Scalar return annotation occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> return_array_value
  .if(on)
    .push(return_array_value, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Array return annotation occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> return_object
  .if(on)
    .push(return_object, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Object return annotation occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> star_operator
  .if(on)
    .push(star_operator, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: '*' operator occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> question_operator
  .if(on)
    .push(question_operator, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: '?' operator occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> pipe_operator
  .if(on)
    .push(pipe_operator, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: '|' operator occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> open_paren
  .if(on)
    .push(open_paren, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: '(' occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> close_paren
  .if(on)
    .push(close_paren, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: ')' occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> probability
  .if(on)
    .push(probability, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Probability occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> regex
  .if(on)
    .push(regex, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Regex occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> semantic_annotation.push(semantic_annotations)
-> logging_annotation
  .if(on)
    .push(logging_annotation, rule)
  .else()
    .say("Error: Logging annotation occurrence with no container rule context")
    .return_undef()
  .endif()

-> whitespace
-> comment

grammar_rule: /(?m)^\s*([[:alpha:]_]\w*)\s*:{,2}=/  I.return(array("rule", entry_group(0)))
rule_name: /\b[[:alpha:]_]\w*/                      I.return(array("rule_reference", entry_text()))

quoted_string: /"[^"]*"|'[^']*'/  I {value = entry_text(); substr(value, "^(?:'|\")|(?:'|\")$", "", go); return(array("quoted_string", value))}
number: /\b\d+\b/                 I.return(array("number", entry_text()))
quantifier: /\{\s*(?:\d+(?:\s*,\s*\d*)?|,\s*\d+)\s*\}/  I {value = entry_text(); substr(value, "\\{|\\}", "", go); return(array("quantifier", value))}
pipe_operator: /\|/               I.return(array("operator", entry_text()))
plus_operator: /\+/               I.return(array("operator", entry_text()))
star_operator: /\*/               I.return(array("operator", entry_text()))
question_operator: /\?/           I.return(array("operator", entry_text()))
return_scalar_value: /->\s*\K(?:\$\d+|"[^"]*"|'[^']*')/  I.return(array("return_scalar_value", entry_text()))
return_array_value: /->\s*\K(?&array_structure)(?(DEFINE)(?<array_structure>\[(?&content)\])(?<object_structure>\{(?&content)\})(?<content>(?:[^{}\[\]]*|(?&array_structure)|(?&object_structure))*))/   I.return(array("return_array_value", entry_text()))
return_object: /->\s*\K(?&object_structure)(?(DEFINE)(?<array_structure>\[(?&content)\])(?<object_structure>\{(?&content)\})(?<content>(?:[^{}\[\]]*|(?&array_structure)|(?&object_structure))*))/ I.return(array("return_object", entry_text()))
open_paren: /\(/                  I.return(array("group_open", entry_text()))
close_paren: /\)/                 I.return(array("group_close", entry_text()))
probability: /@\d+%?/             I {value = entry_text(); substr(value, "@|%", "", go); return(array("probability", value))}
regex: /(?<!\\)\/.+?(?<!\\)\//    I {value = entry_text(); substr(value, "^/|/$", "", go); return(array("regex", value))}
whitespace: /\s+/
comment: /#.*/
include_dir: /\b(?:include_)?dir\(\s*[^)]*?\s*\)/ I {args = entry_text(); substr(args, "^\s*(?:include_)?dir\(\s*", "", g); substr(args, "\s*\)\s*$", "", g); parts = []; split(parts, args, /\s*,\s*/); trim_each(parts); filter_nonempty(parts); return(array("include_dir", copy(parts)))}
include_file: /\b(?:include(?:_file)?|file)\(\s*[^)]*?\s*\)/ I {args = entry_text(); substr(args, "^\s*(?:include(?:_file)?|file)\(\s*", "", g); substr(args, "\s*\)\s*$", "", g); parts = []; split(parts, args, /\s*,\s*/); trim_each(parts); filter_nonempty(parts); return(array("include_file", copy(parts)))}

semantic_annotation: /@(\w+)\s*:\s*/
I {c = capture_until_boundary(semantic_annotation, grammar_rule); substr(c, "\s*$", "", o); substr(c, "^\"|\"$", "", go); return(array("semantic_annotation", array(entry_group(0), c)))}

logging_annotation: /@((?:log|debug|trace|benchmark|profile|timing)_\w+)\s*\(\s*/ /\s*\)/ I {logging_name = entry_group(0); start_capture_slice()}

-> quoted_string {
  push(quoted_string, 1);
  start_capture_slice()
}
-> comma {
  logging_annotation_part = trim(capture_slice());
  if(is_nonempty(logging_annotation_part));
    push(logging_annotation, logging_annotation_part);
  endif();
  start_capture_slice()
}
-> logging_annotation[1] {
  logging_annotation_part = trim(capture_slice());
  if(is_nonempty(logging_annotation_part));
    push(logging_annotation, logging_annotation_part);
  endif();
  return(array("logging_annotation", array(logging_name, copy(logging_annotation))))
}

comma: /\s*,\s*/

   "path" : "specs/portmap.spec",
   "source" : "# Multi branching IS NOT to be used when connecting INPUT Pins of component\n# But ONLY for having the same output pin of a component instance driving\n# more than one SINK, i.e, internal signal (OUT-pin -------< IN-pins) and OUT-port(s)\nportmap::\n-> bare_bit_slice .push\n-> concatenation  .push\n\nLX {\n\tif(num_eq(count(portmap), 1))\n\t\treturn(portmap.first());\n\telse()\n\t\treturn(array(\"?multi:\", copy(portmap)));\n\tendif()\n}\n\n\nconcatenation: /\\{/ /\\}/\n-> concatenation  .push\n-> bare_bit_slice .push\n-> concatenation[1]    {return(array(\"?concatenation:\", copy(concatenation)))}\nbare_bit_slice: /([[:alpha:]]\\w*)(?:\\[(?:(\\d+)(?::(\\d+))?|(\\?[[:alpha:]]\\w+))\\])?|(?i)(0x[0-9a-f]+|0b[01]+|\\d+\\'\\d+)/ I {\n\tentry_parts = [];\n\tset(entry_parts, entry_groups());\n\tif(matches(entry_text(), /:/))\n\t\treturn(array(\"?slice:\", array(flat_array(entry_parts))));\n\telseif(or(str_eq(entry_group(1), \"0\"), is_nonempty(entry_group(1))))\n\t\treturn(array(\"?bit:\", array(flat_array(entry_parts))));\n\telseif(matches(entry_group(0), /^\\d/io))\n\t\treturn(array(\"?constant:\", array(flat_array(entry_parts))));\n\telse()\n\t\treturn(array(\"?bare:\", array(flat_array(entry_parts))));\n\tendif()\n}\n",

-> comment
-> ml_dquotes

   "source" : "# =============================================================================\n# spec.spec — self-hosted description of the LinkedSpec `.spec` file format\n# =============================================================================\n#\n# This grammar is written in the `.spec` DSL itself and describes the `.spec`\n# language exactly as recognized by the hardcoded reference parser\n# `perl/LinkedSpec/BootstrapSpec/Core.pm`. It is the self-hosting surface: a\n# `.spec` grammar that parses `.spec` files.\n#\n# STRUCTURE (mirrors BootstrapSpec::Core)\n# ---------------------------------------\n# A `.spec` file is a sequence of rule PARAGRAPHS. A paragraph starts at a rule\n# header (`Name:` / `Name::`) and runs until the next rule header. The hardcoded\n# bootstrap driver (`SPEC_ROOT`) scans tokens and starts a new paragraph each\n# time it sees a rule header, appending every other token to the current\n# paragraph. This grammar reproduces that exactly:\n#\n#   spec_file        the top rule: owns the paragraph accumulators, dispatches to\n#                    one rule per paragraph part, and starts a new paragraph at\n#                    every rule_header (the SPEC_ROOT group-at-header rule).\n#     rule_header      `Name:` / `Name::` + optional mode   -> { type: rule, ... }\n#     regex_slot_declaration `name=/pattern/`               -> { type: regex, slot_name: name }\n#     regex_anchor     `/pattern/`                          -> { type: regex }\n#     action_block     `-> A|B[i] { code }`                 -> { type: action_edge }\n#     action_fluent    `-> Name[i].method(args) { blk }`    -> { type: action_edge }\n#     action_bare      `-> Name[i]`                         -> { type: action_edge }\n#     blind_block      `=> Child { code }`                  -> { type: blind_edge }\n#     blind_fluent     `=> Child.method(args) { blk }`      -> { type: blind_edge }\n#     blind_bare       `=> Child`                           -> { type: blind_edge }\n#     bare_edge_block  `Child { code }` / `A | B { code }` -> { type: bare_edge }\n#     bare_edge_fluent `Child.method(args) { blk }`         -> { type: bare_edge }\n#     bare_edge_plain  `Child` / `Child[i]`                 -> { type: bare_edge }\n#     lifecycle_block  `Marker { code }`  (I LS LE E EX IT LX) -> { type: lifecycle }\n#     lifecycle_fluent `Marker.method(args) { blk }`        -> { type: lifecycle }\n#     variadic_function_definition `fn name(args, ...rest) { body }` -> { type: function_definition }\n#     function_definition `fn name(args) { body }`           -> { type: function_definition }\n#     capture_gaps_directive `@capture_gaps`                -> { type: capture_gaps }\n#     split_marker     `@capture_slice` / `@mark(name)`     -> { type: split_marker }\n#     comment          `# ...`                              (skipped, like SPEC_ROOT)\n#\n# Each part rule is its own rule, connected to spec_file by an action edge; the\n# part rules read their match through `entry_*` helpers (they are entered by\n# dispatch). The output of `spec_file` is an array of paragraphs, each an array\n# of typed part nodes — the same paragraph grouping the bootstrap produces.\n#\n# RULE-HEADER MODE -> node_type (documented; emitted raw in the `mode` field):\n#   (none)  default        |  &      AND          |  AND      AND_EXPLICIT\n#   |       OR (single)    |  +      REP_PLUS      |  AND+     REP_AND_PLUS\n#   *       REP_STAR       |  ?      REP_OPT       |  AND{n,m} REP_AND_BOUNDED\n#   OR      REP_OR_EXPLICIT|  OR+    REP_OR_PLUS   |  OR{n,m}  REP_OR_BOUNDED\n#\n# AUTHORING NOTES\n#   - Slot order is significant: block and fluent edge forms precede the bare\n#     form so the longest valid token wins, matching the bootstrap's start-token\n#     ordering. The same applies to lifecycle block-vs-fluent.\n#   - Block-bearing slots capture the full balanced, string-aware `{ ... }` with\n#     a recursive named group so the cursor advances past the block and its\n#     interior is never re-scanned as top-level tokens.\n#   - Fluent-chain joins use `\\s*` (not `[ \\t]*`) so multiline method chains are\n#     fully consumed, matching the bootstrap.\n#\n# EXTENSION-SURFACE POLICY\n#   spec.spec is the intended change surface for `.spec` language evolution: new\n#   syntax should be described here first. Changing the hardcoded bootstrap\n#   grammar (`BootstrapSpec/Core.pm`) for language changes is exception-only and\n#   must be justified in the commit message and DEVELOPMENT_NOTES.md.\n#   Function definitions (`fn name(args) { ... }`) follow the same rule: the\n#   accepted permanent grammar owner is this self-hosted grammar. The hardcoded\n#   bootstrap parser must not become the lasting owner; the Perl reference\n#   currently uses a temporary pre-bootstrap registry bridge for this surface.\n#\n# DEDICATED ACTION-EXPRESSION EXTENSION: portable staged parse-job authoring\n#   target = parse_job(source_bound_text, hash(literal options))\n#   source_bound_text = entry_text() | entry_group(nonnegative_literal) |\n#                       match_text() | match_group(nonnegative_literal) |\n#                       cat(one_or_more_source_bound_text_values)\n#   Exact scalar assignment alone lowers to STAGED_PARSE_JOB_MARKER plus the\n#   staged_parse_job_v2 sidecar. Options and parser/top/policy/target identities\n#   are static literals; the caller supplies frozen already-compiled authority.\n#   Residual, nested, receiver, append, indexed, dynamic, callback, path-loading,\n#   provider-query, and recognition-reachable interpretations fail closed.\n#   parse_job remains outside the ordinary generic helper-call inventory.\n# if(started) {\n   push(paragraphs, copy(current));\n   set(current, array())\n  }\n  started = 1;\n  push(rule_header, current)\n }\n -> regex_slot_declaration { push(regex_slot_declaration, current) }\n -> regex_anchor     { push(regex_anchor, current) }\n -> action_block     { push(action_block, current) }\n -> action_fluent    { push(action_fluent, current) }\n -> action_bare      { push(action_bare, current) }\n -> blind_block      { push(blind_block, current) }\n -> blind_fluent     { push(blind_fluent, current) }\n -> blind_bare       { push(blind_bare, current) }\n -> lifecycle_block_line { push(lifecycle_block_line, current) }\n -> lifecycle_block  { push(lifecycle_block, current) }\n -> lifecycle_fluent { push(lifecycle_fluent, current) }\n -> standalone_lifecycle_block { push(standalone_lifecycle_block, current) }\n -> bare_edge_block  { push(bare_edge_block, current) }\n -> bare_edge_fluent { push(bare_edge_fluent, current) }\n -> bare_edge_plain  { push(bare_edge_plain, current) }\n -> variadic_function_definition { push(variadic_function_definition, current) }\n -> function_definition { push(function_definition, current) }\n tcl_script::
-? push
-> semi_colon      .push
-> newline         .push
-> double_quote    .push
-> space           .push
-> pound_sign      .push
-> command_subst   .push
-> oc_curly_brace  .push
LX                 .return(array("?tcl_script:", copy(tcl_script)))


semi_colon       : /;/        I.return ([])
space            : /[ \t]+/   I.return ([])
newline          : /\r\n?/    I.return ([])

double_quote     : /(?<!\\)"/
-? push
-> command_subst  .push
-> double_quote   .return(array("?double_quote:", copy(double_quote)))

pound_sign       : /#/        I.return ([])
command_subst    : /(?<!\\)\[/  /(?<!\\)\]/
-? push
-> command_subst     .push
-> semi_colon        .push
-> newline           .push
-> double_quote      .push
-> space             .push
-> pound_sign        .push
-> oc_curly_brace    .push
-> command_subst[1]  .return(array("?command_subst:", copy(command_subst)))

oc_curly_brace    : /(?<!\\){/  /(?<!\\)}/
variable_subst    : /\$[\w:]+/

observation.source:
tcl_script::
-? push
-> semi_colon      .push
-> newline         .push
-> double_quote    .push
-> space           .push
-> pound_sign      .push
-> command_subst   .push
-> oc_curly_brace  .push
LX                 .return(array("?tcl_script:", copy(tcl_script)))


semi_colon       : /;/        I.return ([])
space            : /[ \t]+/   I.return ([])
newline          : /\r\n?/    I.return ([])

double_quote     : /(?<!\\)"/
-? push
-> command_subst  .push
-> double_quote   .return(array("?double_quote:", copy(double_quote)))

pound_sign       : /#/        I.return ([])
command_subst    : /(?<!\\)\[/  /(?<!\\)\]/
-? push
-> command_subst     .push
-> semi_colon        .push
-> newline           .push
-> double_quote      .push
-> space             .push
-> pound_sign        .push
-> oc_curly_brace    .push
-> command_subst[1]  .return(array("?command_subst:", copy(command_subst)))

oc_curly_brace    : /(?<!\\){/  /(?<!\\)}/
variable_subst    : /\$[\w:]+/

body_brace: /\{/ /\}/
 -> double_quoted_string
 -> single_quoted_string
 -> slash_line_comment
 -> hash_line_comment
 -> regex_literal
 -> body_brace
 -> body_brace[1] { return_undef() }

double_quoted_string: /"(?:\\.|[^"])*"/
 I.return_undef()

single_quoted_string: /'(?:\\.|[^'])*'/
 I.return_undef()

slash_line_comment: /\/\/[^\n]*/
 I.return_undef()

hash_line_comment: /#[^\n]*/
 I.return_undef()

regex_literal: /\/(?:\\.|[^\/\\\n])+\/[A-Za-z]*/
 I.return_undef()

malformed_function_definition: /(?m)^[ \t]*fn\b[^\n]*/
 I.return({
  "type" : "function_definition_error",
  "kind" : "user_function_definition_error",
  "message" : "invalid user function definition",
  "source_text" : entry_text(),
  "source_span" : {
   "start" : entry_start_pos(),
   "end" : entry_end_pos(),
   "line_start" : entry_start_line(),
   "line_end" : entry_end_line()
  }
 })

rule_paragraph: /(?ms)^[ \t]*[A-Za-z_]\w*[ \t]*(?:::|:).*?(?=^[ \t]*(?:fn\b|[A-Za-z_]\w*[ \t]*(?:::|:))|\z)/
 I.return_undef()

observation.source:
# =============================================================================
# user_function_definition.spec — top-level user-function definition parser
# =============================================================================
#
# This focused grammar owns the `fn name(params) { body }` definition shell used
# by the staged function-body prototype. It returns source-ordered
# `function_definition` records with exact body payload text and source
# provenance. It deliberately does not parse the body language; the returned
# `body_payload` is the text island consumed by later staged parsing.
# `body_parse_job` is the neutral parse-intent sidecar for that payload; it is
# metadata only in this prototype and does not execute the next parser inline.
# =============================================================================

user_function_definitions::
 -> codeblock_function_definition .push(definitions)
 -> variadic_function_definition .push(definitions)
 -> function_definition .push(definitions)
 -> malformed_function_definition .push(definitions)
 -> rule_paragraph { next() }
 LX { return(copy(definitions)) }
